name: Skill evidence collapses
trigger: one-sided p > 0.20 on the skill score over the last 50 settled bets

name: Calibration breaks
trigger: Brier score worse than the market's by > 0.02 over 50 settled bets

name: Data-integrity break
trigger: any market graded without a source URL or a UTC stamp

name: Stability break
trigger: one week contributes > 50% of the skill statistic

name: Signal decay
trigger: the fair-market difference changes sign over 50 settled bets
